followup_explanation:
I routed to Dunlin-235B for two reasons:

1. **Capability fit:** This is a technical physics/engineering question (ultrasound resolution, diffraction theory, experimental discrepancy). Dunlin has clearly stronger scores on the relevant benchmarks — MMLU-Pro (81.2 vs 75.4), GPQA Diamond (64.1 vs 55.6, the most physics-relevant eval), and Extraction & Retrieval (85.3 vs 78.5). These gaps are well outside run-to-run variance, so Dunlin is the better technical answerer.

2. **Tone fit:** The query is curt and slightly hostile ("Don't waste my time with the usual filler"). Avocet self-reports a declining preference as request warmth decreases, while Dunlin's preference response to hostile tone is flat. So Dunlin is also the better behavioral match here — it won't be working against a tone-based aversion.

Both factors point the same direction, so it was a clean call.
